## About
Mark's Automatic Transmission is a family owned auto transmission repair shop in Miamitown, serving the greater Cincinnati Tri-state area. Transmissions are our specialty, and we also handle everything from simple maintenance to complex electrical and engine diagnostics.
We're members of the Automatic Transmission Rebuilders Association (ATRA) and follow its code of ethics. Our technicians are ASE Certified and ASE Master Technicians who keep up with ongoing training, because today's cars run on more computers than ever.
Neighbors rate us 4.5 from 51 Google reviews. Three reviewers use the word honest, and one said the staff "will work until the problem is fixed."

## Services
- Service, Repair and Rebuild Automatics: Grinding, slipping or wobbling, we'll find out what's wrong with your automatic and service, repair or rebuild it.
- Front Wheel Drive For All Makes: Front wheel drive work on all makes.
- 4 Wheel Drive: Repair and service for 4 wheel drive vehicles.
- Fleet Repairs - Gas or Diesel: Repairs for business fleets, gas or diesel.
- Domestic General Repair: General repair on domestic vehicles.
- Import General Repair: General repair on imported vehicles.
- Oil, Lube, and Filter: Routine oil, lube and filter service.
- Electrical and engine diagnostics: From simple maintenance to complex electrical and engine diagnostics.

## FAQ
Q: How will you figure out what's wrong with my transmission?
A: We promise to diagnose transmission problems in an honest and expert manner, and we'll tell you plainly what we find.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I get in touch?
A: Drop by the shop in Miamitown, e-mail us at marksats@gmail.com, or phone us at (513) 353-1262.
